temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor. In conversation, Shirley says the loss has been tough, wonders if there was something more they could have done, and says it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows Shirley cared about the patient and may be affected by the death, but she has not yet confirmed how deeply Shirley is grieving or whether Shirley feels self-doubt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara's suspicion is confirmed and deepened; Shirley is not merely sad but is struggling with grief and possible self-blame.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply affected by the patient's death and is having difficulty letting go; she needs reassurance and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Compassionate concern, empathy, and sadness for Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort Shirley, validate the care they provided, and offer reassurance that she is not alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara brings up the patient's treatment. Shirley says she feels responsible and wonders whether pushing for a different approach might have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving deeply and may have doubts about the outcome, but she has not yet heard Shirley explicitly claim personal responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Shirley's own words confirm and intensify Sara's belief that Shirley is carrying guilt and a heavy sense of responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels personally responsible for the patient's outcome and is burdened by 'what if' thoughts; she needs help reframing that burden and sharing it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy, concern, and a desire to relieve Shirley's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Shirley that the treatment decisions were reasonable with the information available, and encourage her not to carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley continuing to be reserved and minimally expressive. When Sara confronts her, Shirley says she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak, but she agrees to try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and feeling responsible, and has been trying to support her, but she may not yet understand why Shirley is still emotionally closed off.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara learns that Shirley is suppressing emotions because she fears appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley may be willing to open up with encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is holding back her feelings due to fear of judgment; she needs explicit permission and a safe, nonjudgmental space to express herself.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and cautious hope that Shirley may become more open.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her emotions and reassure her that vulnerability is healthy and acceptable.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says they should keep talking because it helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worries that her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and may have strained her friendship with Shirley or made Shirley feel pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Shirley's response reassures Sara that the relationship is intact, her good intentions were understood, and Shirley values continued conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is still open to support and that their friendship can continue through honest, caring communication.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief, gratitude, and some lingering remorse for having pushed too hard.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend any rift, stay available to Shirley, and continue supportive talks without being overly forceful.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley seems better. Shirley says she is feeling better thanks to their talks and Sara's support. Shirley agrees to spend more time together outside work, suggesting a weekend plan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is still recovering but has been willing to talk and that their supportive conversations have been helpful; she is not fully certain how much Shirley has improved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Sara's belief that support is helping is confirmed; Shirley reports improvement and is receptive to a closer, more social connection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is improving with support and is open to spending time together outside work, indicating growing trust and recovery.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend time with her outside work to further strengthen their friendship and her well-being.
